title: The Stainless Sky
summary: A calm, purifying sign. Conditions are clear and protected, but progress may be steady rather than fast. This is a sign of purification, balance, and removal of obstacles. Your situation is fundamentally safe and supported.

interpretation.meaning: This result points to a protected foundation in life, family, and vitality. Intentions can be fulfilled without major obstruction, especially when grounded in virtue and reliance on enlightened help. Relationships and material support are present, though they may need care to remain stable over time. Health is sound, disturbing influences are minimal, and the overall pattern is one of calm clearing rather than dramatic change. Other matters can succeed, but often gradually rather than all at once.
interpretation.meaningShort: Protection, purification, and steady support.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is especially favorable here. Unwholesome tendencies can be abandoned, meditation can deepen, and obscurations can be thoroughly purified.
interpretation.caution: Friends, wealth, or resources may not stay with you unless you care for them intentionally. Some outcomes unfold slowly.

title: The Flaming Rays of the Sun
summary: A bright, clarifying sign. Doubt lifts, understanding sharpens, and matters become easier to resolve. This reading favors clarity, discernment, and forward movement. Good results are likely when you act with confidence and virtue.

interpretation.meaning: This sign brightens circumstances through insight and decisiveness. Family, property, and life go well when supported by virtuous action. Aspirations can succeed once doubt is cut through, and this is especially strong for study, learning, and thoughtful judgment. Wealth and support improve somewhat, though gains may come through auspicious objects, fortunate conditions, or clearer choices rather than sheer force. Health tends toward quick recovery, and the whole pattern suggests illumination, right understanding, and the removal of confusion.
interpretation.meaningShort: Clarity dispels doubt and supports good decisions.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Practice supports increasing intelligence, learning, and contemplation. This is a strong sign for mental refinement and clearer understanding on the path.
interpretation.caution: Projects tied to land, houses, or heavy physical structures may need extra care.

title: The Nectar Rays of the Moon
summary: A gentle, nourishing sign. Peaceful and supportive actions prosper, especially those requiring care rather than force. This is a soft but auspicious reading. It supports healing, kindness, domestic harmony, and gradual increase.

interpretation.meaning: This result brings a cooling, restorative influence. It favors family life, fertility, nourishment, and gentle increase. Aspirations move ahead without major obstruction when approached peacefully rather than aggressively. Friends, food, drink, and white or lunar qualities are supported. Health trends toward recovery, particularly with cold or digestive imbalances. In relationships and practical affairs, softer, easier, or more receptive movements are better than forceful action.
interpretation.meaningShort: Gentle growth, healing, and peaceful increase.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is wholesome and naturally increasing. A virtuous mind is strengthened here, and good qualities tend to grow when cultivated gently and consistently.
interpretation.caution: Forceful, aggressive, or fire-related efforts are less favored.

title: The Bright Star
summary: A promising sign for movement, travel, giving, and action taken with steadiness and attention. Good results are available if you stay focused and do not let the mind scatter. Momentum is available, but it must be guided.

interpretation.meaning: This sign favors movement, travel, messages, offerings, and outward activity. Life conditions improve through devotional actions, right timing, and motion rather than stagnation. Aspirations involving going somewhere, delivering something, or opening pathways are supported. Wealth may arrive through practical goods, animals, letters, or news rather than fixed accumulation. Health may show air-related agitation or mental restlessness, but not severe danger. Relationships and wider matters can go well, though watery or overly diffuse undertakings are somewhat weaker.
interpretation.meaningShort: Movement and offerings open the way forward.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice goes well, especially if undertaken somewhere other than your usual place. A shift of setting supports fresh energy and favorable results.
interpretation.caution: Agitation, mental restlessness, and water-related activities may create minor complications.

title: The Ground of Gold
summary: A stable, grounded sign. Long-term foundations are strong, though progress may take time. This reading supports steady work, remaining rooted, and building something durable. The future is solid if you are patient.

interpretation.meaning: This is a sign of stability through staying grounded in your own place and not scattering your efforts. It favors enduring plans, strong intentions, and long-term gain, though the fruits may arrive gradually. Wealth and support improve over time rather than immediately. Health points to mild phlegmatic or slow-moving conditions that are not severe but may take patience to resolve. In relationships and practical concerns, rootedness, locality, and steadiness are stronger than constant movement or chasing messages and opportunities.
interpretation.meaningShort: Grounded effort brings long-term stability.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is favorable in the long run, especially when continued steadily in one place. Consistency and rooted discipline are the key strengths of this sign.
interpretation.caution: Results may come slowly. Communication-heavy or air-like activities may be less reliable.

title: The Tone of the Vajra
summary: A bright sign for intelligence, learning, artistry, and the fulfillment of thoughtful intentions. This is a refined, auspicious reading that supports study, creativity, scholarship, and clear-minded accomplishment.

interpretation.meaning: This sign points to success through intelligence, refinement, and blessed support. Life and vitality are strengthened through long-life practices and peaceful devotional activity. Aspirations tend to be fulfilled directly. Happiness and favorable conditions increase around friends and resources. The broader pattern supports learning, culture, creativity, and pleasing accomplishment more than struggle. It is a gentle but powerful sign for any endeavor guided by wisdom and grace.
interpretation.meaningShort: Wisdom, refinement, and blessing support success.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is especially helped by contemplations that increase intelligence and eloquence. This is a good sign for practices connected with learning, speech, and mental clarity.
interpretation.caution: Do not be distracted by appearances of trouble when the deeper movement is actually favorable.

title: The Bright Lamp
summary: A sign of clarity and self-reliance. Plans can succeed, though illness or fatigue may temporarily worsen. Your mind is capable of seeing clearly now. Obstacles are limited, and direct effort can bring success.

interpretation.meaning: This result suggests illumination through your own effort. Intentions can succeed and the present situation around resources is fairly sound. The main caution lies in health, since illness may worsen before improving, or conditions may feel more intense for a time. Spiritual and practical progress is possible when you rely on your own clarity rather than waiting for others to act. The wider pattern is positive, though not entirely effortless.
interpretation.meaningShort: Self-reliance and clarity carry the answer forward.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice done on your own is unobstructed. This sign supports solitary effort, direct engagement, and inner steadiness.
interpretation.caution: Health needs attention. Trouble may come from past causes rather than current hostility.

title: Adding Butter to the Burning Flames
summary: A fiery, energizing sign. Power, attraction, momentum, and rapid accomplishment are amplified. This reading brings force, charisma, and quick movement. It strongly favors decisive action and influence.

interpretation.meaning: This is an intensified fire sign: visibility rises, goals move quickly, and active effort gains sharp potency. Aspirations can be fulfilled rapidly, especially through strong mantra, ritual, or confident intervention. Wealth may increase through fiery, dry, or red qualities. Relationships and circumstances can be magnetized by your presence, but this energy is easier to direct than to contain. Health may require treatment where heat, blood, contagion, or intensity are involved. Earth- and water-bound matters are less stable under this sign.
interpretation.meaningShort: Force and momentum are amplified.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice supports virtuous action and also stronger rites of power. When used wisely, energy gathers and beneficial force increases.
interpretation.caution: Large plans can become messy if they are poorly designed. Earth and water matters are less favored.

title: The Demon of Death
summary: A difficult sign of obstruction, decline, and vulnerability. This is not a time to force outcomes. Plans are easily extinguished under this reading. Delays, losses, or danger may arise if you push ahead carelessly.

interpretation.meaning: This is one of the more severe warnings in the cycle. Life energy, aspirations, wealth, and supportive relationships all show obstruction or depletion. Serious illness, especially cold or fluid-related conditions, requires caution and may be difficult to turn quickly. Friends and resources are scarce, and major plans are better postponed than forced. The result is especially unfavorable for ordinary ambitions, travel, and dependence on favorable timing. Only harsher or destructive actions are oddly strengthened here, which itself is a warning to turn away from them.
interpretation.meaningShort: Severe obstruction calls for caution and postponement.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice faces great obstacles and requires protection, refuge, prayer, and corrective ritual. This is not a sign of ease; the path asks for purification, humility, and strong remedial support.
interpretation.caution: Major efforts, travel, illness, and conflict all require caution. This is one of the more severe warnings.

title: The King of Power
summary: A commanding sign of strength, victory, and decisive impact. You have force behind you. This reading favors courageous action, overcoming opposition, and bringing strong intentions into form.

interpretation.meaning: This is a powerful result for victory, leadership, and energetic accomplishment. Life and vitality are protected, intentions can be fulfilled through strength, and wealth tends to increase. Opposition is weak, guests or opportunities arrive quickly, and even active illness is not dangerous. The tone is martial, forceful, and confident. It supports compelling action, conquest of obstacles, and reliance on protector energy, though it is less ideal for watery or highly yielding undertakings.
interpretation.meaningShort: Strength rises and obstacles can be overcome.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice meets its aims strongly. Whatever sacred intention is held can be accomplished well under this sign.
interpretation.caution: Use power wisely. Intensity is high, and overreach or aggression can become excessive.

title: The Dried-Up Tree
summary: A weak sign. Effort may not bear fruit, and enthusiasm may fade before results arrive. This reading suggests limited yield. What is attempted may dry out or lose momentum before completion.

interpretation.meaning: This sign warns of force without endurance. Goals are difficult to complete, wealth is scarce, and the impulse to grasp at happiness or special gain is likely to disappoint. Health may show a temporary bilious flare or strain, but without great danger. Relationships and practical matters suffer most when you insist on immediate satisfaction. Delays, simplification, and releasing excess desire are wiser than pressing harder.
interpretation.meaningShort: Momentum burns out before it ripens.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual effort is weakened by too many wishes at once. This is not a sign of concentrated practice, but of scattered desire pulling you away from deeper accomplishment.
interpretation.caution: Do not expect quick gains in wealth, support, or major ambitions.

title: The Door of Auspicious Visions
summary: A good sign of guidance, insight, and beneficial openings. Success comes through good counsel and wise alignment. This reading supports growth through vision, instruction, and spiritual or intuitive clarity.

interpretation.meaning: This result favors openings that come through good guidance rather than solitary force. Intentions can succeed when shaped by wise friends, teachers, or ritual instruction. Wealth and supportive relationships increase when cultivated diligently. Health benefits from rituals and right care. The wider tone is auspicious for visionary practices, divination, purification, and activities that reveal hidden patterns. It is a sign of help arriving through counsel, vision, and timely insight.
interpretation.meaningShort: Guidance opens the way to success.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is favorable, especially where purification of conduct, vows, or precepts is concerned. This sign supports clearer alignment and cleaner intention on the path.
interpretation.caution: Success improves when you listen to trustworthy advice rather than acting impulsively.

title: The Vase of Nectar
summary: A soothing and beneficial sign. Peaceful aims, healing, and support from others are strongly favored. This is a nourishing, restorative reading. Blessings come through receptivity, peace, and alignment with what is wholesome.

interpretation.meaning: This sign brings replenishment and blessing. Aspirations can be fulfilled without obstruction, especially when aligned with benefactors, teachers, or healing intentions. Friends and wealth are beneficial and supportive. Medical care and ritual become especially potent, and recovery is favored. Relationships, peace-making, and restorative processes flourish. The overall current is one of nectar-like support, making this one of the gentlest and most reassuring results.
interpretation.meaningShort: Restoration and blessing flow easily.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Peaceful spiritual activities are favored, especially those that purify obscurations and support healing, receptivity, and devotional clarity.
interpretation.caution: Even when successful, outcomes may feel quieter or less dramatic than expected.

title: The Pool Without a Source of Water
summary: A sign of depletion. Something may appear workable for now, but its source of support is weak. This reading warns of decline through lack of true nourishment or continuity. Gains may not last.

interpretation.meaning: This result shows support that is running dry. Aspirations are only moderately viable and help from friends may not truly benefit you. Wealth or gains may arise briefly but fail to endure. Health shows bodily disturbance and serious unwellness if not tended properly. Relationships are especially vulnerable, and broader matters trend unfavorable. The core issue here is weak source energy: outward form remains, but sustaining power is missing.
interpretation.meaningShort: Resources appear, but the source is weak.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice does not produce good results easily under this sign. Confusion, mixed intention, and faulty methods interfere with progress, so sincere correction is needed.
interpretation.caution: Wealth, energy, and plans may drain away unless renewed at the source.

title: The Ocean of Nectar
summary: A rich and abundant sign. Prosperity, nourishment, harmony, and ease of accomplishment are favored. This reading points to fullness, support, and smooth progress. Resources and cooperation tend to increase.

interpretation.meaning: This is a strong sign of increase, abundance, and gentle flourishing. Family and life conditions are good and continue to improve. Intentions bring wealth and favorable circumstances. Friends, resources, and nourishment become plentiful, and old hostilities soften. Health is manageable unless a water-related condition dominates. Relationships harmonize, tasks are easily accomplished, and the wider environment becomes more supportive. It is especially good for growth, ease, hospitality, and the accumulation of sustaining support.
interpretation.meaningShort: Abundance and harmony increase naturally.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is excellent, especially peaceful forms. Peaceful practice ripens into peaceful attainment under this sign.
interpretation.caution: Water-related imbalances or excessive attachment may need attention. Fire-related commitments may be less ideal.

title: The Demon of Afflictions
summary: A troubled sign of agitation, conflict, and emotional or energetic disturbance. This reading indicates unrest. Plans may be undermined by anxiety, conflict, hidden opposition, or disruptive conditions.

interpretation.meaning: This result shows turbulence in mind and circumstance. Aspirations are disturbed by unhappiness and mental agitation, wealth is unstable, and movement can be hampered by pain, strain, or nervous imbalance. Relationships may sour through conflict, separation, or emotional reactivity. Health points to air-type disorders, tendon or vein issues, and painful agitation. It is a sign of unrest that can easily spill into the body, the mind, and one’s connections with others if not calmed early.
interpretation.meaningShort: Agitation erodes clarity and stability.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is hindered by disturbed mind, unhappiness, and the danger of breaking vows. Protective and pacifying support is needed before deeper practice can settle properly.
interpretation.caution: Conflict, legal trouble, travel mishaps, and stress-related illness are more likely under this sign.

title: The Golden Lotus
summary: A beautiful sign of ripening, increase, and beneficial results that grow steadily over time. This reading supports prosperity, influence, generosity, and the gradual maturation of good conditions.

interpretation.meaning: This is a sign of graceful increase. Intentions improve steadily, wealth and beneficial relationships grow, and health recovers gradually but well. It supports teaching, generosity, reputation, and gathering others through genuine benefit. Present conditions may not yet show their full beauty, but the future trend is positive. It is especially good for ripening what has already been planted rather than forcing a sudden breakthrough.
interpretation.meaningShort: Steady increase ripens into beauty and benefit.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual intentions increase here, and Dharma teaching or sharing can attract and benefit others naturally. The sign supports growth through sincerity, generosity, and beneficial influence.
interpretation.caution: Progress may be slightly slower than desired even when the direction is clearly good.

title: The Nectar-Like Medicine
summary: A healing and fortunate sign. Plans align well, support is present, and remedies are effective. This reading suggests strong benefit, nourishment, and fulfillment. What you are trying to do can succeed in the form you envision.

interpretation.meaning: This sign is deeply supportive for healing, practical success, and the fulfillment of envisioned aims. Wealth increases, desires are met in wholesome ways, and health improves when good advice is followed. Relationships and help from others are nourishing rather than draining. The overall current is medicinal: what is needed appears, remedies work, and outcomes can match the heart’s clearer intention.
interpretation.meaningShort: Healing support and fulfillment come together.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice goes well because conduct and character are aligned in a pleasing way. Your path can unfold according to your deeper wish rather than against it.
interpretation.caution: Success is strongest when you follow good advice rather than improvising carelessly.

title: The White Umbrella of Good Fortune
summary: A sign of blessing and uplift, with good news and support, though not every promise fully materializes. Fortune rises here, and protection is present. The reading is supportive, especially for encouragement and renewal.

interpretation.meaning: This result brings auspicious breath and a feeling of uplift. Intentions are fulfilled, especially when tied to prayers, recitation, or good news. Wealth can improve when offerings and fortunate alignment are present. Health appears safe, and the overall condition is protected. Still, there may be a slight gap between hope and complete materialization, so it is best received as fortunate encouragement rather than absolute certainty.
interpretation.meaningShort: Blessing and encouragement arrive under protection.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is successful. The path is open and protected, especially when approached with faith, auspiciousness, and devotional steadiness.
interpretation.caution: Not every plan becomes concrete. Promises or intentions may lack follow-through.

title: The Great Fiery Weapon
summary: A victorious sign for decisive action, forceful effort, and overcoming opposition. This reading favors triumph, strength, and the successful completion of difficult undertakings.

interpretation.meaning: This is a result of fierce victory. Aspirations succeed through strength and force, wealth may be obtained through assertive action, and enemies can be overcome. Health does not show major danger. It supports cutting through obstruction, especially in competitive or high-pressure conditions. The emotional tone is intense, but productive when directed skillfully. This is not gentle success; it is victorious success.
interpretation.meaningShort: Victory comes through force and sharp resolve.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Powerful or wrathful forms of practice produce clear results under this sign. It supports energetic methods that cut through obstruction.
interpretation.caution: Use force with compassion and restraint. This energy is potent and should not become harsh for its own sake.

title: Empty of Intelligence
summary: A sign of confusion, dissipation, and plans slipping through your hands. This reading suggests that worry, distraction, or poor containment are undermining your efforts.

interpretation.meaning: This result shows mental agitation and leakage. Small goals are burdened by disproportionate worry, wealth is difficult to hold, and advice may not be heard. Health points to mild cold or air imbalance and disturbance in the bodily elements. Relationships and plans are weakened by instability of mind more than by outer attack. It is a sign that asks for steadiness, merit, discipline, and reducing needless mental turbulence.
interpretation.meaningShort: What is held cannot yet be contained.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Because the mind is unsettled, spiritual wishes are difficult to accomplish. Before deeper progress, the mind needs stabilization and ethical clarity.
interpretation.caution: Money, support, and focus may leak away. Avoid pursuing unstable ideas or hostile relationships.

title: The Streamer of Fame
summary: A sign of recognition, renown, and visible success. Your name or work can travel widely now. This reading supports success that becomes known publicly. Influence and reputation can increase.

interpretation.meaning: This result favors fulfillment, visibility, and swiftness. Intentions can succeed, wealth comes quickly, and even health disturbances are not dangerous. The sign is especially good for endeavors that benefit from public notice, protector support, or visible momentum. Relationships and undertakings gain force through recognition and clear standing. Earth and water matters require somewhat more care, but the central pattern is strong and stable.
interpretation.meaningShort: Success becomes visible and widely known.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual aims can be fulfilled with strong success, and renown may arise from practice or beneficial activity. This is a sign of visible accomplishment.
interpretation.caution: Excess can undermine itself. Large ambitions may need to be broken into smaller, manageable wins.

title: The Mara Demon of the Aggregates
summary: A heavy warning sign. Core areas of life may feel cut down, obstructed, or destabilized. This reading signals serious obstruction, depletion, or pressure on foundational matters.

interpretation.meaning: This is one of the heaviest results in the set. Aspirations face strong obstruction, fortune does not carry forward cleanly, friends and wealth are weak, and health may be burdened by thick, difficult conditions. The emotional and practical sense is of being pressed down or diverted from the right road. Relationships, resources, and movement all become constrained. It is a time for humility, clearing obstacles, and not mistaking pressure for a call to force harder.
interpretation.meaningShort: Heavy obstruction presses on life and fortune.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Though there may be some wish for the Dharma, practice is easily diverted in the wrong direction. Obstacle-clearing and corrective support are more important than ambitious spiritual striving here.
interpretation.caution: Family, wealth, health, and luck may all be strained. This is a time for humility and remedial action, not force.

title: The House of Good Tidings
summary: A fast-moving, auspicious sign. Good news, swift success, and helpful connections are favored. This reading supports positive developments that arrive quickly. Communication and relationships are especially blessed.

interpretation.meaning: This sign is bright, active, and immediately encouraging. Aspirations can succeed quickly, relationships with others are favorable, and wealth or useful news arrives without much delay. Health is not burdened. The atmosphere supports movement, social harmony, and successful follow-through. It is particularly good for tasks involving contact, coordination, and the quick opening of opportunities.
interpretation.meaningShort: Good news and quick results arrive together.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual activities increase here because the intention behind them is good. This sign supports wholesome activity, momentum, and beneficial expansion on the path.
interpretation.caution: Take advantage of the opening while it is fresh; the energy here is strongest when acted on promptly.

title: The Golden Mountain
summary: A stable and dignified sign. What has already been established is firm and likely to hold. This reading favors continuity, endurance, and the preservation of what matters most.

interpretation.meaning: This is a sign of solidity and long-range steadiness. Aspirations support future stability, earlier gains remain secure, and there is no danger in health. It favors preserving what is already in place, strengthening commitments, and taking the long view. Relationships and resources endure through steadiness rather than novelty. Delays in travel or movement may occur, but they do not overturn the basic goodness of the result.
interpretation.meaningShort: What is established remains firm.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is firm and good through steadiness and strength. This sign supports reliability, vow-keeping, and durable progress.
interpretation.caution: Arrival and completion may be delayed, but the underlying result remains favorable.

title: The Demon of the Heavenly Son
summary: A destructive sign of instability, desire-driven error, and serious obstruction. This reading warns that a promising situation may be scorched by impatience, ego, or destabilizing forces.

interpretation.meaning: This is a difficult result in which aspirations fail to come fully to completion and both resources and support can burn away. Health is more serious here, especially in hot, blood, or contagious conditions. The whole pattern is sharp, unstable, and destructive when not consciously calmed. It is a poor sign for ordinary accomplishment, though destructive or cutting actions may perversely work well. That contrast itself is part of the warning.
interpretation.meaningShort: Destructive heat destabilizes what might otherwise succeed.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice requires repeated pacifying and remedial effort to avert major obstacles. This is a sign for cooling, healing, and turning away from impulsive force.
interpretation.caution: Health, travel, plans, and emotional judgment may all be compromised. Do not rush.

title: The Overflowing Jewelled Vessel
summary: A prosperous sign of increase, nourishment, and fortunate return. This reading suggests replenishment, gain, and welcome support. Resources and goodwill gather around you.

interpretation.meaning: This is a sign of return, replenishment, and satisfaction. Happiness of mind increases, friends and wealth return and grow, and illness can be cured with a renewed sense of well-being. Relationships are supported by abundance and restored harmony. This result carries a feeling of being refilled after want or strain. It supports prosperity, contentment, and a favorable restoration of what matters.
interpretation.meaningShort: What was depleted returns in abundance.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice goes well and succeeds. The path is supported by good conditions and by a renewed sense of fullness rather than lack.
interpretation.caution: Some things may arrive a little later than hoped, but the direction remains positive.

title: The Scattered Mountain of Sand
summary: A sign of erosion and instability. What was built may break apart or lose cohesion. This reading points to gradual deterioration, loss of momentum, or plans being scattered by changing conditions.

interpretation.meaning: This result shows weakening structure. Aspirations may change repeatedly and eventually decline, new gains do not arise, and what was accumulated may diminish. Health is not terribly dangerous but still needs support. Relationships and broader plans are vulnerable to drift, fragmentation, and a lack of meaningful result. It is not a sign of immediate catastrophe so much as slow dispersal unless corrective grounding is applied.
interpretation.meaningShort: What is loose continues to scatter.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual goals are difficult to achieve here because the future trend is not strong. This is not a stable sign for sustained accomplishment on the path.
interpretation.caution: Accumulated resources may diminish, and news or events may bring disappointment.

title: The Mansion of Gold
summary: A broad, stable sign of abundance, endurance, and future security. This reading favors lasting prosperity and strong foundations. It suggests ample support over time.

interpretation.meaning: This sign combines wealth with steadiness. Intentions are good and can be fulfilled, though there may be some delay. Resources become extensive in the future, and even prolonged illness does not bring lasting harm. Relationships and commitments are durable, and spiritual discipline holds firm. The tone is deeply grounded, prosperous, and suitable for serious long-term building rather than quick shifts or unstable experiments.
interpretation.meaningShort: Lasting prosperity rests on strong foundations.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is steadfast, especially in keeping vows and sustaining disciplined intention. Wishes can be fulfilled through constancy rather than haste.
interpretation.caution: Some matters may move slowly. Illness may linger, even if the outcome is ultimately safe.

title: The Treasury of Jewels
summary: A strong sign of stored blessing, fulfilled wishes, and durable prosperity. This reading points to wealth, support, and long-range success emerging from a stable base.

interpretation.meaning: This result is excellent for secure prosperity and a stable future. Intentions are firm and favorable, wealth fulfills your wishes, and illness clears gradually. Relationships and support gather around grounded success rather than volatility. It is a sign of treasure already present or steadily accumulating, making it especially good for longer plans, durable gains, and practical blessing.
interpretation.meaningShort: Stable treasure supports future success.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is very favorable. It supports solid devotional reliance and the steady accumulation of blessing and accomplishment.
interpretation.caution: Some results mature over time rather than instantly, but the long view is excellent.

title: Manjushri Appears
summary: A highly auspicious sign of wisdom, protection, and direct fulfillment. This reading carries a sense of blessing, authority, and aligned success. Support arrives through wisdom and right view.

interpretation.meaning: This is one of the clearest auspicious results. Doubt should be released, because authority and truthfulness support the matter. Wealth increases, illness resolves naturally, and goals can be fulfilled without deception. The sign favors wise judgment, confidence, spiritual blessing, and reliance on noble support. Relationships and worldly aims are strengthened by clarity rather than force.
interpretation.meaningShort: Blessed authority and wisdom support the answer.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is good, brings happiness of mind, and supports fulfillment of wishes. This sign carries a direct blessing into the path.
interpretation.caution: Do not let doubt weaken a reading that is fundamentally strong.

title: The Endless Auspicious Knot
summary: A harmonious sign of beautiful unfolding, mutual support, and success through connection. This reading brings happiness, coherence, and favorable conditions in relationships, place, and decision-making.

interpretation.meaning: This sign is excellent for harmonious continuity. Intentions are appropriate and succeed, conditions in one’s home or present environment support well-being, wealth and joy increase together, and illness tends to clear quickly. Relationships are particularly favored because this is a sign of connection without interruption. The whole pattern suggests rightness, auspicious interweaving, and progress that feels naturally supported.
interpretation.meaningShort: Harmony and continuity carry things forward.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual wishes are fulfilled and signs of advancement begin to appear. This is a favorable omen for steady unfolding on the path.
interpretation.caution: The energy is excellent; the main task is simply to stay aligned and not create unnecessary complications.

title: The Golden Female Fish
summary: A sign of agility, luck, and graceful progress. Good fortune moves quickly and naturally. This reading supports successful movement, growing support, and healthy momentum in many areas of life.

interpretation.meaning: This is a smooth and fortunate result. Intentions succeed, wealth multiplies, and illness clears. It favors movement that is graceful rather than forceful, and it supports study, medicine, practical service, and well-guided progress. Relationships and outer conditions tend to cooperate rather than resist. The sign suggests ease, mobility, and auspicious good luck.
interpretation.meaningShort: Graceful progress and good fortune align.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is good and shows progress. This is a favorable sign for gentle but real advancement.
interpretation.caution: The sign is broadly positive; results tend to unfold in good time rather than all at once.

title: The White Conch
summary: A sign of reputation, message, and beneficial news. Voice and communication are highlighted. This reading favors teaching, speech, announcements, and becoming known for something worthwhile.

interpretation.meaning: This result supports successful communication, instruction, and recognition through voice, language, or knowledge. Intentions succeed and good tidings are heard. Wealth may come in the form of good news or favorable information rather than simple accumulation. Health is not burdened. The sign works especially well for teachers, speakers, debaters, and anyone whose work depends on expression and message.
interpretation.meaningShort: Good news and worthy reputation are amplified.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice can bring fame or renown here, especially where the sharing of teachings, recitation, or public beneficial speech is involved.
interpretation.caution: Mental agitation may accompany illness even when the underlying danger is low.

title: The Golden Wheel
summary: A sign of prosperity, standing, and stable authority. Long-term success is supported. This reading points to dignity, order, and beneficial control over circumstances.

interpretation.meaning: This sign favors social standing, proper conduct, long-range success, and steady increase of resources. Intentions are good over time, wealth grows, and illness eventually resolves even if some spiritual displeasure or delay is involved. Relationships and worldly affairs benefit from order, reputation, and patience. It is a dignified sign that matures well rather than exploding into quick results.
interpretation.meaningShort: Dignity and patience lead to enduring success.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice has good fortune behind it and can succeed well. This is a sign of favorable momentum sustained over time.
interpretation.caution: Recovery or completion may take a little longer than hoped, even though the outlook is good.

title: The Jeweled Banner of Victory
summary: A triumphant sign of excellence, fulfillment, stability, and victory in what you undertake. This is one of the strongest readings in the system. It indicates powerful accomplishment, protection, and results beyond expectation.

interpretation.meaning: This is a supreme result of victory, excellence, and fulfilled desire. Intentions are realized very well, wealth gathers, illness clears naturally, and supportive conditions exceed expectation. Relationships, practical aims, and broader undertakings all tend toward success. It is a sign of rising above obstruction and carrying a victorious current into both worldly and spiritual life.
interpretation.meaningShort: Excellence, victory, and fulfillment prevail.
interpretation.spiritualPractice: Spiritual practice is exceptionally clear and bright. Diligent reliance on your deity or core practice can bring major attainments, strong understanding, and outstanding success on the path.
interpretation.caution: Success is high, but it should still be carried with humility and care.
